title: ABI offset fact
description: One row of a layout table a page prints (Offset | Field | Size | ...): the documented offset of a named member, quoted as the page prints it. Derived: the integer offset read from the offset cell (offset_printed keeps the cell), size read from the size cell, and matches_declared_member (whether the same page declares that member in a syntax block). Never inferred: a member the page gives no offset for has no record.

offset.description: Derived from the offset cell (decimal or 0x hex).

offset_printed.description: The offset cell, exactly as printed.

size.description: Size cell as a number, when the table prints one and its unit is known; null otherwise.

size_printed.description: The size/length cell, exactly as printed.

matches_declared_member.description: The name is a member the same page declares in a syntax block (array suffix and case ignored).

table.description: The header cells of the table, as printed (the statement that the column is an offset).

row.description: Every cell of the row, as printed; the evidence a checker re-reads.
